title: Character (qwen/lora_dataset/characters/*.json)
description: One character per JSON file under qwen/lora_dataset/characters/. Appearance comes from the reference images, not tag arrays. Passed to Qwen-Image-Edit-2511 as Image 1 to Image 3. Output size follows the first image.

name.description: Identifier used in filename_prefix and prepended to caption.txt. Use a unique token when it is also the LoRA trigger (e.g. sks_character).

images.description: Reference image paths, one to three. Output size follows the first image. When using more than one, name their roles in generation.json prompt (Image 1, Image 2, Image 3). Resolved relative to the process working directory when not absolute.
